__comments.Version: Configuration schema version. Used for in-app migrations when fields change.
__comments.Seed: Global seed for deterministic runs. Can be overridden by Training.Seed or CLI.
__comments.SessionDurationSeconds: Maximum duration of a single game session in seconds.
__comments.FramesForCatch: Number of consecutive frames the Seeker must be sufficiently close to catch the Hider.
__comments.ActionRepeat: How many simulator frames to repeat a chosen action (frame-skip).
__comments.NoProgressDistanceEps: Minimal distance improvement considered as progress (meters).
__comments.NoProgressSeconds: If no progress for this many seconds, apply NoProgress penalties.
__comments.MinInitialSeparation: Minimum grid distance between initial Seeker and Hider placements.
__comments.InitialPlacementMaxAttempts: Max attempts to place agents respecting separation constraints.
__comments.TimeScale: Simulation time scale multiplier (1.0 = real time; >1.0 speeds up).

__comments.BatchSize: Number of transitions to sample per optimization step.
__comments.StepsPerUpdate: Environment steps per network update (frame skipping for learning).
__comments.Device: Auto/CPU/GPU. Auto prefers GPU when available; falls back to CPU.
__comments.DataRoot: Root folder for models and logs; absolute or relative.
__comments.ModelsPath: Subfolder under DataRoot for model checkpoints.
__comments.AutosaveSeconds: Autosave interval for checkpoints in seconds.
__comments.CheckpointKeepLast: How many recent checkpoints to retain.
__comments.ResumeFromLatest: If true, resume training from the latest checkpoint in ModelsPath.
__comments.Seed: Optional override for global seed; if set, overrides GameConfig.Seed.

__comments.Hidden1: Size of the first hidden layer in the Q-network.
__comments.Hidden2: Size of the second hidden layer in the Q-network.
__comments.UseHuberLoss: If true, use Huber loss; otherwise use MSE.
__comments.MaxGradNorm: Clip gradients to this L2 norm (0 or negative disables).
__comments.UseAdamW: If true, use AdamW optimizer; otherwise Adam.
__comments.WeightDecay: L2 weight decay (AdamW decoupled weight decay).
__comments.RewardClipAbs: Clamp |reward| to this value before scaling.
__comments.RewardScale: Scale multiplier applied to rewards after clipping.
__comments.UpdateTargetEvery: Hard target network update period in steps (used when UseSoftTarget=false).
__comments.UseSoftTarget: If true, use soft target updates with tau; else hard updates every N steps.
__comments.TargetUpdateTau: Soft target interpolation factor tau in [0,1].
__comments.EpsilonDecay: Multiplicative decay per step (or per update depending on integration).

__comments.Size: Maximum number of transitions stored in the buffer.
__comments.WarmupSize: Number of initial steps collected before training begins.
__comments.BetaFrames: Number of frames over which Beta transitions from start to end.

__comments.WallHeight: Height of walls in meters (for 3D rendering/visibility).

__comments.FpsHeadless: Target FPS cap in headless mode (frame pacing).

__comments.MinNeighborDistanceEps: Minimal distance epsilon to treat agents as non-overlapping.

__comments.RetainedFileCountLimit: How many rolling log files to keep (0 or negative = unlimited).
__comments.FlushToDiskIntervalSeconds: Flush interval for log file sink in seconds.

__comments.TurnLeft: Rotate left by a fixed angle.
__comments.TurnRight: Rotate right by a fixed angle.
__comments.Count: Total number of distinct actions; must equal the number of defined actions.

__comments.ApplyVisibilityRewardsToRL: If true, apply visibility rewards to RL training signal for the Seeker.
__comments.VisibilityRewardScaleRL: Scale factor for visibility rewards applied to RL.
__comments.VisibilityPointsScaleHUD: Scale for HUD visibility points (UI only).
__comments.EnableHudVisibilityPoints: Show visibility points on HUD for this role.
__comments.UsePotentialShaping: Use potential-based shaping when configured for the Seeker.
__comments.ForceExploitWhenSeen: If true, when Seeker is seen by Hider, force greedy action on that step.
__comments.EnableFleeHeuristic: Enable 'run from threat' heuristic when under threat.
__comments.PreferTurnAndMoveWhenAligning: Prefer ForwardLeft/ForwardRight over pure turns when aligning during flee.
__comments.AlignThresholdDegrees: Explicit angular threshold for Forward vs Turn+Move during alignment (0=use TurnAlignFactor).

__comments.EnableHudVisibilityPoints: Show visibility points on HUD for this role.
